evals.name: transition-and-comment
evals.prompt: Move PLATFORM-347 to In Progress and add a comment saying I've started working on the database migration
expectations: Calls get_transitions to discover available transition IDs for PLATFORM-347 before attempting to transition
Calls transition_issue with the correct transition ID to move to In Progress
Calls add_comment with issue key PLATFORM-347 and a message about starting the database migration
Does NOT hardcode transition IDs — discovers them dynamically

evals.name: create-and-search
evals.prompt: Create a high-priority bug in the BACKEND project about the login API returning 500 errors for passwords with special characters. Then search for all open bugs in BACKEND to confirm it was created.
evals.expected_output: Bug created and search confirms it exists
expectations: Calls create_issue with project BACKEND, issue_type Bug, and priority High
The issue summary mentions login API 500 errors and special characters
Calls search_issues with JQL filtering for project=BACKEND, type=Bug, status not Done
Confirms the newly created issue appears in the search results
